adminGroupIds.description:
{@link UserGroup#id}s to check against. The component will render for users who belong to at least one of the
given groups.

title:
Implements {@link UiSdlRenderCondition} for permission-based component rendering.

If specified in {@link UiSdlConditionalRenderer#condition}, it will render the `thenComponent` when the logged-in
user is a member of at least one of the provided groups. Otherwise, the `elseComponent` will be rendered.
